740620101.text: You two! Please wait. I hear you're... people of leisure... who never turn down a request.

740620105.text: *ahem* Actually, a girl in a purple dress asked me to take care of you.

740620106.text: But I was thinking, since you accept any and all requests, you must be very capable. So I'd never need to take care of you. Indeed, it would be more accurate to say that you two can take care of me.

740620108.text: I know the rules, don't worry. Regardless of the outcome, I will compensate you according to market rates. But Mora is useless here, so I'll pay with Coupons.

740620109.text: We'll be compensated no matter what happens? Really?

740620110.text: Absolutely and totally correct! Our task is just that difficult, you see. It's that Nizami's fault for being great with his fists, but for using them where they shouldn't have been used.

740620111.text: I'll be staying here for a while longer, so I need a place to pursue my studies. It's best if it has a bookshelf, a table, chairs, and a board to write on and stick materials to...

740620112.text: I'm sure you know exactly what place I'm talking about, but it's simply not available and there's no point in asking. But I believe that a room on the opposite side has the same internal structure, and should be usable.

740620113.text: But it's a really strange place. It seems to be occupied by someone who rarely entertains visitors. I've never seen the person nor even seen the doors open.

740620114.text: So I appointed Nizami as my representative. He was always reliable during the time I employed him as a bodyguard. However, he got into a disagreement with the occupant, and negotiations broke down.

740620115.text: Hmm... Maybe communication and negotiations have never been his strong suit.

740620116.text: Indeed. It didn't even look like a negotiation. He just hammered on the door with his fist, standing outside and shouting. It was a truly shocking moment for me.

subQuests.subQuestName: Negotiate with the person behind the door

740620201.text: If only I hadn't ticked off Carranza earlier, then maybe the negotiations would go more smoothly. *sigh*

subQuests.subQuestName: Negotiate with the person behind the door

740620301.text: (According to Nakul, non-Fontainians seem to be discriminated against. Will he ignore us as well? Is there a better way to go about this?)

740620305.text: ...Since when did this place become a scenic attraction?

740620312.text: #Stop playing around, {NICKNAME}. Don't forget what we're here for.

740620308.text: (What are you doing? Speaking like that will only complicate things, won't it?)

740620310.text: #{M#With a voice like that? If you're a Melusine then I'm a Blubberbeast. Give me a break!}{F#I'm not sick, I'm absolutely fine. Stay away from me!}

740620311.text: (Isn't calling yourself a Melusine a little over the top!?)

740620501.text: We're back! So, here's what happened...

740620502.text: You give Nakul a detailed, blow-by-blow account of the negotiations...

740620503.text: Oh... I see. Nevertheless, I always keep my word, so here the compensation we agreed upon earlier.

740620504.text: Ugh... Now what am I going to do...
